title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool | TechCrunch
summary: Anthropic announced Thursday that Claude is getting a new tool called “Personal Finance,” designed to help users keep track of their money. For instance, Anthropic launched Claude for Legal and Claude for Financial Services earlier this year.
